## Change summary

Describe the change and its intended security/operational effect.

## Evidence and validation

- [ ] Linked issue, baseline SHA, affected paths, and change scope recorded
- [ ] Tests executed with actual logs and run identifiers (or `NOT_EXECUTED` stated)
- [ ] No secrets, private keys, credentials or personal data included
- [ ] Least privilege, action SHA pinning and untrusted-input boundaries reviewed
- [ ] Existing release HOLD / deny checks preserved
- [ ] Concurrent `main` changes checked before merge
- [ ] Independent reviewer requested; own approval is not used as independent evidence
- [ ] Deployment and production claims match actual observed evidence

> This template is advisory. Merge enforcement depends on GitHub rulesets and required status checks.
